summary: Prepare MXFP4-CSF scales for native MXFP8 expert activations
compatibility: Canonical checkpoint bytes are unchanged. Pair with the vLLM DS4.1 activation-policy update. Kimi retains BF16 expert activations.
details: MXFP4-CSF supports the native W4A8 prepared scale layout, including compact N64 tails, native E8M0 clamping and caller-owned shared scratch.
Compressed-scale expansion skips absent experts using a bounded presence mask instead of repeatedly scanning route prefixes or assuming every expert is active.

The DS4.1 TP4 batch execution-rate regression is reduced to approximately 1.4 percent or less at concurrency 8 through 32 in the measured configuration. NVFP4 serving retains a material regression; its complete repair is not claimed.
